title: Example: assess a storage assumption and challenge it
request: Example request: assess whether keeping delivery measurements in the port jurisdiction is consistent with the baseline, then have the assessment challenged.
objective: Produce a maritime assessment of the residency assumption, then an independent challenge of it. Read-only: no files are changed.

risks.text: The assessment may treat a cloud region as proof of port-jurisdiction residency.
risks.mitigation: The acceptance tests require the result to cite the requirements and the critic task checks the claim; HC-01 says a region choice is not proof.

tasks.title: Assess the residency assumption
tasks.objective: Explain what the baseline requires for delivery measurement data and list the assumptions an architecture would need to prove, without proposing a design.
tasks.recovery: The task writes nothing. If it fails, discard its captured result and re-delegate with the failed checks in the prompt.

tasks.title: Challenge the assessment
tasks.objective: Independently challenge T1: find unsupported claims and missing constraints, and end with a verdict line.
tasks.recovery: The task writes nothing. If it fails, discard its captured result and re-delegate with the failed checks in the prompt.
